prose: Basis: the Wall Street Journal blocks automated fetching (HTTP 403), so this note rests on Techmeme's account. Venture capital is largely absent from Anthropic's S-1, with one exception: Spark Capital, which invested roughly $800 million across six rounds and whose GP Yasmin Razavi is the sole VC on Anthropic's board. The cap table's shape - strategic and institutional money rather than a syndicate of firms - is itself part of the IPO story.
highlights: Few VC firms appear in Anthropic's S-1 - Spark Capital is the exception
Spark invested ~$800M across six rounds; GP Yasmin Razavi is the only VC on the board
The cap table skews strategic and institutional rather than traditional venture syndicates
